top_signals.title: US Stock Futures Rise as AI Woes Ease, Oil Slips: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: US equity-index futures edged higher in early Asian trading as investors returned to risk assets following last week’s selloff, offering signs that concerns over the artificial intelligence trade may be easing. Oil slipped.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Airlines work to restore flights as FAA probes faulty router
top_signals.summary: After canceling more than 6,600 flights on Saturday, airlines scrapped nearly 1,900 on Sunday, with more than 6,300 others being delayed.
